SCOPE OF SERVICE The Contractor shall provide enterprise -grade mobile and data services to the U.S. Embassy Panama. The prices listed below shall include all labor, service, equipment, technical support, materials, insurance (see FAR 52.228 -4 and 52.228- 5), overhead, and profit. The Government will pay the Contractor on a monthly basis for routine services that have been satisfactorily performed. The Contractor shall ensure that all services are delivered with high availability, reliability, and performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. The Contractor shall offer two different plans to fulfill the Government needs: Basic Plan. Pay per use for actual calls (local, local long distance, international long distance), incoming and outgoing roaming calls, incoming and outgoing local SMS, incoming and outgoing international SMS, incoming and outgoing roaming SMS. Unlimited Smart Phones & Tablets Plan. A flat monthly rate per cellphone line that includes unlimited: local data, local minutes on-net, local minutes off-net, national long-distance minutes,

When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

GENERAL The U.S. Government requires Health and Life Insurance for its Locally Employed Staff (LES) of the United States Embassy Lisbon, Portugal and their eligible dependents as described herein. The Contractor shall provide health insurance services under this contract to eligible employees at U.S. Embassy Lisbon and U.S. Consulate Ponta Delgada, Azores. TYPE OF CONTRACT 1. This is a fixed-price indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity (IDIQ) with economic price adjustment requirement under which annual firm-fixed price task orders will be issued. The fixed premium rates for the health insurance services as specified in Section C – Statement of Work provided herein are provided in Attachment 3 – Pricing Schedule. The quantities set forth in the pricing section are estimates; the Government does not guarantee that such quantities will be ordered. 2. The contract will be for a one base year period and four (4) one-year periods. In accordance with FAR 52.217-8, the contract may be extended by additional six (6) months period. Services shall commence no later than January 01, 2027. The Government is obligated only to the extent of authorized task orders actually made under this IDIQ. 3. Payments will be made only to the extent specifically authorized in the task order. Each task order will fund a specific period of time and number of covered individuals. ACQUISITION METHOD This is a commercial acquisition as defined in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101, Definitions, and as described in FAR part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services.
